_comment: Delta reuse allowlist (issue #2203): jobs of ci.yml that a tier=main dispatch with delta=true may skip when the newest same-tree pull_request run has them green. Reasoning: the never-list holds jobs whose inputs live outside the tree (audit: the RustSec advisory DB; changes/test-selection/package-selection/package-version-bump: the selectors whose delta path never runs; test-selection-verdict/test-duplicates/every cancel-after-*: aggregators and watchers that must see the delta run itself; the reuse job itself). The runtime package jobs (hermes/pi/codex/claude-package) and sdk stay out: they read the release baseline digest from the pull_request-only package-selection, so on a dispatch they would run without it, which is not the pull request's green result. A job whose needs: names a reusable job but that can never run on a tier=main dispatch (test-selection-check is pull_request-only, test-selection-audit is nightly-only) is not a consumer for the closure: it never reads the artifact on the dispatch path, so it lives in not_dispatch_consumers, and the guard requires its job-level if: to restrict it to pull_request or schedule. Dynamic-matrix fast-tests lists the legs of the FULL selection one by one and is selection_dependent: a narrowed source never reuses them, so the full leg list is the only one that can be reused, and the guard derives it from the same matrix source the workflow uses. Consumers include non-allowlisted jobs too (for example sdk of build-bins): the closure must drop a producer whose artifact a running job still downloads in the same run.

not_dispatch_consumers.test-selection-check: pull_request-only: its job-level if: requires github.event_name == 'pull_request'
not_dispatch_consumers.test-selection-audit: nightly-only: its job-level if: requires schedule or (workflow_dispatch with tier == 'nightly')
not_dispatch_consumers.sdk: its producers are not all reusable: hermes-package reads the release baseline digest from pull_request-only package-selection

build-bins.reason: compiles the workspace test archive from the lockfile; identical on the same tree

build-tests.reason: default-feature build of the shipped binaries; the closure keeps it when sdk runs

darwin-check.reason: aarch64-apple-darwin clippy of the same tree

names: docs check (schema + drift + source-map + runbooks + secrets + release)
docs.reason: docs check of the same tree

doctests.reason: documentation tests of the same tree

fast-tests.reason: full-selection legs run every test of the shard; a narrowed source never reuses them

feature-matrix.reason: feature powerset of the same tree

hermes-compatibility-macos.reason: Hermes macOS job on the same tree; reused only with its daemon producer

integration.reason: heavy suite runs from the archive with the full selection only

macos-package.reason: macOS package acceptance; its nightly-only cold-rebuild step runs on neither path

macos-release-build.reason: release daemon build; the closure keeps it when its consumers run

macos-tier.reason: tier archive built from the lockfile; no same-run artifacts

platform-contracts.reason: macOS lane runs identically when the selection does not narrow the lane away

release-build.reason: release build of the same tree

sdk-macos.reason: SDK checks built from the same tree on macOS

shear.reason: unused-dependency check of the same tree

systemd-supervision.reason: builds the daemon, worker and CLI from the lockfile; nothing reads the selection

test.reason: formatting and lints of the same tree

ts-drift.reason: TypeScript binding drift of the same tree

udeps.reason: unused-dependency check of the same tree
